content.comment_body: Hello, I'm adapting a program to read data from a PAC2200 meter into [product_name], which functions well so far. Now, I need to read from an ABB M4M meter, but I'm having trouble with the address configuration. I found a discussion here suggesting to add 400001 to the address, but [product_name] software only allows entering 5-digit addresses. For example, I'm interested in Voltage address 23296. I do have a connection to the meter and can read address 578 (from the PAC2200 configuration), but the result appears incorrect.
Do you have a manual listing the Modbus addresses, or a link where it can be accessed?
I've uploaded a spreadsheet containing all the relevant addresses.
I've also provided the Modbus manual for the meter.

Hello, are there any updates regarding this issue? I'm also attempting to set up communication and trying to read the value at address 4098 (plus a 1 offset). Still unsure about the device ID number. Thanks in advance.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are encountering difficulties translating Modbus addresses when integrating an ABB M4M meter with [product_name] via [product_name] software, primarily due to software limitations on address field length. While device connections are established, obtaining correct measurement values is problematic, resulting in confusion and uncertainty regarding address mapping and expected outcomes.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to input Modbus addresses for the ABB M4M meter and retrieve measurement data accurately with the [product_name] software. They anticipate a user-friendly experience without restrictions from address field limits or translation complications.
